title: TD Mailer API Deployment on VPS
summary: FastAPI backend deployed at /opt/td-mailer-api/ on Megahost_02 VPS (180.93.144.98:8401). Handles Lead Discovery (web scraping + Google CSE + SalesQL enrichment) and Email Sending (Gmail API via toan.dang@tdgamestudio.com, 30/day limit). Systemd service: td-mailer-api.service (enabled, auto-restart). Firewall: UFW port 8401 open. Frontend connected via VITE_OUTREACH_API_URL in .env.local. Supabase tables: crm_outreach_leads, crm_email_log, crm_email_templates with open RLS. API keys in /opt/td-mailer-api/.env (SalesQL, Google CSE, Supabase anon). Gmail OAuth token at /opt/td-mailer-api/credentials/gmail_token.json (auto-refresh). Verified: discovery found 5 Supercell contacts (Tier 1-3). Next steps: import 553 leads, domain warm-up, cron follow-ups, reply detection.
